name: Gautam Buddha Nagar (Noida)
notes: Gautam Buddha Nagar (Noida): NHB RESIDEX HPI at assessment prices (appraised values of financed homes), quarterly, 2013 Q2 to 2026 Q2 (53 quarters). 2017-18 = 100 base (back-cast by the NHB to 2013) chain-linked onto the 2024-25 base on the NHB's three overlap quarters. The market-price (under construction) index stops in Sep 2024. Carpet-area bands are weighted-average prices per sq ft, shown as relative movements. NHB terms require its written permission for reproduction: credit the NHB; removable on request.
